import (
	"strings"

	pd "github.com/arturoeanton/go-pandas"
)

csv := `month,region,sales
Jan,North,120
Jan,South,95
Feb,North,132
Feb,South,101
Mar,North,151
Mar,South,110
Apr,North,142
Apr,South,125
May,North,168
May,South,131
Jun,North,175
Jun,South,140`

df, err := pd.ReadCSVReader(strings.NewReader(csv))
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}

byRegion, _ := df.GroupBy("region").Sum("sales")
north, _ := df.Where(pd.Col("region").Eq("North"))
south, _ := df.Where(pd.Col("region").Eq("South"))

ShowHTML(
	ShowDF(byRegion) +
		BarChart(ColS(byRegion, "region"), ColF(byRegion, "sales"), "Total sales by region") +
		LineChart(ColS(north, "month"), []string{"North", "South"},
			[][]float64{ColF(north, "sales"), ColF(south, "sales")}, "Monthly sales by region"))

import (
	"strconv"

	"github.com/arturoeanton/go-dsl/pkg/dslbuilder"
)

calc := dslbuilder.New("Calc")
calc.Token("NUMBER", "[0-9]+")
calc.Token("PLUS", "\\+")
calc.Token("TIMES", "\\*")
calc.Rule("expr", []string{"NUMBER", "PLUS", "NUMBER"}, "add")
calc.Rule("expr", []string{"NUMBER", "TIMES", "NUMBER"}, "mul")

calc.Action("add", func(args []interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
	sa := args[0].(string)
	sb := args[2].(string)
	a, _ := strconv.Atoi(sa)
	b, _ := strconv.Atoi(sb)
	return a + b, nil
})
calc.Action("mul", func(args []interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
	sa := args[0].(string)
	sb := args[2].(string)
	a, _ := strconv.Atoi(sa)
	b, _ := strconv.Atoi(sb)
	return a * b, nil
})

sum, _ := calc.Parse("2+3")
prod, _ := calc.Parse("6*7")
sum.GetOutput()
prod.GetOutput()

// ReadSQL / SQLExec run compiled in the server: "sqlite" (no cgo) and
// "postgres" drivers are built in.
import "os"

os.Remove("demo.db")
SQLExec("sqlite", "demo.db", `CREATE TABLE sales (month TEXT, region TEXT, amount REAL)`)
SQLExec("sqlite", "demo.db", `INSERT INTO sales VALUES
	('Jan','North',120),('Jan','South',95),('Jan','East',88),
	('Feb','North',132),('Feb','South',101),('Feb','East',97),
	('Mar','North',151),('Mar','South',110),('Mar','East',105),
	('Apr','North',142),('Apr','South',125),('Apr','East',118)`)

df, err := ReadSQL("sqlite", "demo.db",
	`SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total, AVG(amount) AS avg
	 FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total DESC`)
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}

ShowHTML(
	ShowDF(df) +
		PieChart(ColS(df, "region"), ColF(df, "total"), "Sales share by region"))

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	gx "github.com/arturoeanton/go-xml/xml"
)

data := `<library>
	<book id="1"><title>El Principito</title><year>1943</year></book>
	<book id="2"><title>Rayuela</title><year>1963</year></book>
</library>`

m, err := gx.MapXML(strings.NewReader(data), gx.ForceArray("book"))
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
}

title, _ := gx.Query(m, "library/book/title/#text")
id, _ := gx.Query(m, "library/book/@id")
fmt.Println("first title:", title)
fmt.Println("first id:", id)

# Go Notebook

Welcome! Run each cell with the **play button** or **Shift+Enter**.

These libraries ship precompiled with go-notebook — they import instantly, no network needed:

- [go-pandas](https://github.com/arturoeanton/go-pandas) — DataFrames for Go
- [go-dsl](https://github.com/arturoeanton/go-dsl) — build small languages
- [go-xml](https://github.com/arturoeanton/go-xml) — XML parsing and queries

Charts render as native SVG — `BarChart`, `LineChart`, `AreaChart`, `ScatterChart`, `Histogram`, `PieChart` — with hover tooltips and no external plotting engine.

Helpers available in every cell: `ShowDF`, `ShowGrid`, `ShowHTML`, `ReadSQL`, `SQLExec`, the chart helpers, and `ColF`/`ColS` to pull DataFrame columns as slices.
